description: Give the end-of-game pass to up to `limit` (default 10, at most 25) of your finished war.app games not yet processed, newest first: each game's history is read ONCE from GameFeed (never again, whatever comes of it) and kept name-free for the opponent profiles, map records and lessons — what warapp_my_games does two games per call. `window` widens how many of your newest finished games are considered (default 250, at most 500). Reports what it processed and how many remain; safe to call again until `remaining` is 0. It also gives map records kept before the winners' income curves were those curves, from the histories already kept (`winnerCurves`, no request). Writes only this server's state and never writes to war.app. Reads through your signed-in war.app tab (ContextMint Bridge), so it sees exactly what you see — fog included.

limit.description: Games to process this call (default 10, max 25).

window.description: How many of your newest finished games to consider (default 250, max 500).

name: warapp_backfill_history
title: Process more finished war.app games at once
